reply.summary: Rimon is a night-hunting sleuth who breaks into a fairy-tale mystery over a bloodied toy. Rimon interrogates cowering suspects, ghosts through shadows, and fears that one more cruelty will push a lifelong vow past its limit.

feats.scene: Rimon puts a fleeing suspect through a plank door with one shoulder charge.
Rimon drops two storeys onto a car roof and keeps tracking the trail.

reply.summary: Nelasi is a grey-haired original of the cowled kind who gets whisked to an orbiting outpost for a team-up of wildly mismatched crimefighters. Nelasi takes the chaos with a weary shrug.

feats.scene: Nelasi hurls a bladed disc that clips a mercenary's rifle from his grip.
Nelasi rides out a zero-gravity brawl against a bulkhead.

reply.summary: Unllolu is an angry, brooding protector who claims credit for a night free of violence, then must confront a copycat wearing the same cowl. Unllolu hides behind a reclusive corporate life and years of therapy.

feats.scene: Unllolu slams a gunman through a sheet of laminated glass.
Unllolu takes a baton barrage and a rooftop fall without slowing.

reply.summary: Sistinan is a masked detective trailing a mobster, a former protege's hurt and a grinning escapee who wants to prove everyone is one bad day from ruin. Sistinan insists that hope is not lost.

feats.scene: Sistinan drives a fist through a carnival-stall wall to reach a captive.
Sistinan keeps walking through a funhouse shootout with a grazed ribcage.

reply.summary: Llotauvi is a gravel-voiced animated guardian who trades quips with a puzzle-obsessed rival in short cartoon episodes. Llotauvi escapes every trap by wriggling free at the last second.

feats.scene: Llotauvi flips a trapdoor guard into a stack of crates.
Llotauvi stands up after a cartoon anvil flattens his hood.

reply.summary: Nananrno is a timid, grey-faced heir from a pocket reality who never took up a mask. Nananrno was twisted into a half-ruined menace by a scheming parent and cowers when real heroes crash in through the cellar.

feats.scene: Nananrno swings a fire poker wildly and shatters a vase and a window.
Nananrno tumbles down cellar steps and whimpers on the landing.

reply.summary: Milesis is a stubby, big-headed cartoon guardian in a kindergarten-sized world who frets over missing flying critters and mentors a small sidekick. Milesis once mistakes lost visitors for a rival's children.

feats.scene: Milesis tosses a rubber disc that bonks a toy robber off a shelf.
Milesis tumbles off a play-sized staircase and bounces up smiling.

reply.summary: Lorsir is an aged protector dying of radiation after building a watchful satellite. Lorsir orders a loved cousin to end his life and erase his tools, only to be proven right when the satellite refuses and a hard-eyed successor rules by fear.

feats.scene: Lorsir overloads a lab console and wipes out a bank of secret equipment.
Lorsir keeps working while sickness gnaws at his frame.

reply.summary: Numelaral is a blue-eyed, hairless soul who appears in a single anthology story and dies within it. Numelaral stands for a vanished world apart from the others, remembered more as a tragic image than a fighter.

feats.scene: Numelaral heaves a rusted lever and opens a jammed shutter.
Numelaral stumbles through a wrecked corridor and still stands.

reply.summary: Tecorli is a vat-grown copy who wakes long after a ruined planet has been scoured. Tecorli is told he is a madman locked in a ward before learning the truth, then fights beside amazon exiles and a foster boy with borrowed memories.

feats.scene: Tecorli rams a padded-jacket elbow through a ward door and leaps out.
Tecorli takes a staff beating from a pack of mutated orderlies and keeps moving.

reply.summary: Anuoro is an unstable copy of a famous hero, grown by a tyrant of a fire-pit world and never quite alive. Anuoro is passed off as a corpse, revived as a ghost-ring servant, then runs amok through a manor until shocked and beaten down.

feats.scene: Anuoro hurls a man off a manor rooftop without effort.
Anuoro shrugs off a high-voltage cable pressed to his chest.

reply.summary: Linser is a teenage clone bred by a robot to be an expendable sidekick, given stolen memories and a body that ages fast. Linser wakes in an alley, snarls at crooks, and finally gives away his own hand before wrinkling into peace.

feats.scene: Linser breaks a mugger's wrist and dumps him in a bin.
Linser staggers to his feet after a rooftop collapse.

reply.summary: Rnoiumra is a cheery boy who befriends a flying neighbour and is wrongly blamed for pranks caused by imp children. Rnoiumra tries to copy a famous father, fails, and founds a kid duo that travels the highway solving cases.

feats.scene: Rnoiumra throws a pillow-stuffed dummy that knocks a crook off a fence.
Rnoiumra tumbles off a bike into a hedge and laughs.

reply.summary: Nalleo is a purple-skinned, red-eyed courtier in a stern star-empire, hungry for his master's chair and a fierce believer in brutal laws against women. Nalleo plots to kill a secretly female ruler and fails.

feats.scene: Nalleo drives a ceremonial spear through a banquet table.
Nalleo takes a palace guard's blow and remains standing.

reply.summary: Starnir is a bald, emerald-skinned peacekeeper who wields a will-powered ring and a charging lantern. Starnir patrols a sun-baked desert planet until raiders armed with yellow lasers cut him down, and the corps honours his memory.

feats.scene: Starnir shapes a glowing wall and crushes a raider skiff against a dune.
Starnir holds a shimmering barrier against a barrage of yellow beams.
Starnir streaks between desert moons in a ring-lit arc.

reply.summary: Nanrniter is a brown-furred ape bride of a famous cub reporter, a one-time spouse whose marriage ends in divorce. Nanrniter is revered as holy among her own kind and somehow tolerated by humans.

feats.scene: Nanrniter pounds a hollow log and splinters it in a single blow.
Nanrniter tumbles from a branch and bounds up unhurt.

reply.summary: Aulntuval is an ape starlet who rose from jungle roots to screen fame and left a reporter husband behind. Aulntuval now dates an intelligent troublemaker simian and prefers premieres to fights.

feats.scene: Aulntuval smashes a prop door on a film set in a take that goes wrong.
Aulntuval walks off a collapsed stage set with only a ruffled coat.

reply.summary: Iumeor is the commander of a sisterhood of river spirits and battle-maidens who ferry the fallen to a feasting hall. Iumeor rallies her warriors to aid a freed island, then guards a golden river treasure from a ravenous menace.

feats.scene: Iumeor hurls a spear that splits a siege tower and throws the rubble across a field.
Iumeor holds a gorge bridge as a war-host charges across it.
Iumeor swoops over the valley on a winged mount at storm speed.

reply.summary: Ntstia is a fair-haired bouncer-type hired muscle who lingers on the edges of other people's stories. Ntstia guards doors, cracks knuckles, and has no great plan beyond collecting a wage.

feats.scene: Ntstia lifts a rowdy patron and hurls him through a tavern door.
Ntstia takes a chair across the back and grunts.

reply.summary: Nteialcor is a friendly diner proprietor who sits behind a counter and lends quiet help to a professional stand-in who takes bullets for clients. Nteialcor knows old stories and serves second helpings of noodles.

feats.scene: Nteialcor swings a heavy skillet at a would-be robber and connects.
Nteialcor stays standing after a shoving match behind the counter.

reply.summary: Riava is a thick-set crime-syndicate chief who worships a creed of villainy and burns with a rage-fed ring in his darkest hours. Riava rules from a sprawling city mansion and bellows orders to goons.

feats.scene: Riava vomits a blaze of crimson fury that scorches a limousine to its frame.
Riava shakes off a hail of pistol fire in a blood-red haze.

reply.summary: Teiumti is a sharp-suited underworld boss who runs a smuggling ring in a glass-towered city. Teiumti hires hardware from a cosmic warlord, glares out of shadowy offices, and meets his end in a planet-level showdown.

feats.scene: Teiumti orders a gang of goons to blast open a vault with alien weapons.
Teiumti shrugs off a thrown chair and straightens his tie.

reply.summary: Nusil is a cult-minded racketeer who runs the shadowy side of a vast metropolis, inheriting the business from a ruthless father. Nusil keeps order through leadership and a talent for making people afraid.

feats.scene: Nusil slams a ledger on a table and a lieutenant goes pale.
Nusil sits calmly through a heated, table-flipping mob meeting.

reply.summary: Olureo is a red-haired, hot-tempered convict drafted from a military stockade into a ragged commando squad during a global conflict. Olureo is short on brains but loyal to his lieutenant, spraying a submachine gun at every beachhead.

feats.scene: Olureo empties a submachine gun into a bunker door and blows it from its hinges.
Olureo crawls from a shell crater with a torn sleeve.

reply.summary: Leseium is a red-eyed, bald thug bulked up on a toxic drug and hired by a masked luchador-type mastermind. Leseium bashes through walls and shrugs off bullets until a final battle ends him.

feats.scene: Leseium pounds a steel door off its frame and flings it across a courtyard.
Leseium takes a point-blank assault-rifle burst and merely scowls.

reply.summary: Nauorsa is a bald, green-skinned nightmare who serves a lord of slumber with a slobbering companion. Nauorsa builds a private pocket of sleep inside a boy's mind, tricks a scientist into heroics, and is hauled back by a returning master.

feats.scene: Nauorsa warps a dreamscape and drops a cliff onto a marching squad.
Nauorsa re-forms after a mystic blast scatters his shape.

reply.summary: Ranerau is a white-eyed, hairless sidekick of a sleepy hero in a goofy teen-team cartoon. Ranerau tags along on a heartbroken evening and pats his hero on the back as they trudge home.

feats.scene: Ranerau shoves a bean-bag chair across the floor in a huff.
Ranerau gets squashed by a cartoon sofa and pops out round again.

reply.summary: Rnistra is a brown-haired thug in a hidden mountain tribe who despises his peaceful kin. Rnistra rigs blasting charges that cleave his people from the world, then terrorises the remaining men until a champion shows up.

feats.scene: Rnistra sets off a cavern charge that tears a slope off its mountain.
Rnistra takes a rival's fist to the jaw and spits blood.

reply.summary: Incolnt is a green-skinned, blond inventor of a far-future alien lineage, heir to a famed machine-minded ancestor. Incolnt bends circuitry with his mind, assists a royal house, and falls when a crimson tyrant besieges a sanctuary fortress.

feats.scene: Incolnt wills a vault's machinery into a barricade that crushes a raider ship.
Incolnt withstands a corridor blast long enough to seal a hatch.

reply.summary: Niesni is a former gridiron star and computer professor turned test subject for a procedure that left him unable to be hurt and unable to rest. Niesni helps a flying amazon thwart his tormentor and later vanishes under a fresh name.

feats.scene: Niesni tackles a guard against a lab wall in a football charge.
Niesni walks away unscathed from a car crashing into him.

reply.summary: Reourn is a white-furred, yellow-eyed engineered lynx kept as a pet by a polar-fortress genius. Reourn stalks hallways with fangs and claws, protective of her owner until she meets a fatal end.

feats.scene: Reourn rakes a steel door and leaves four deep grooves.
Reourn absorbs a heavy crate falling from a gantry and snarls.
Reourn bounds down a frozen corridor at a lightning-fast sprint.

reply.summary: Iumiria is a red-furred, blue-eyed cloned cat grown as a living compass to find a vanished blue god. Iumiria claws, bites and drinks in power from what she touches, serving a brilliant schemer who hopes to bring peace.

feats.scene: Iumiria soaks up a burst of raw force and releases it in one shattering pounce.
Iumiria lands from a stratospheric drop and prowls on.

reply.summary: Taunenliu is a short-tempered former gang member and student mutated by a tainted gas into a hulking meat-eating lizard that retains speech and wit. Taunenliu is now a heavy for a rival crimelord.

feats.scene: Taunenliu stomps through a brick wall in saurian form and brings the roof down.
Taunenliu takes a shotgun volley on scaly flanks and charges on.

reply.summary: Ransta is a masked fiend who fights with floating spheres of shimmering film and hounds a team of fearless adventurers in a single outing. Ransta pops out of shadows, blows glittering orbs, and is gone by the last page.

feats.scene: Ransta floats a bubble that bursts into a concussive pop and flips a truck.
Ransta sinks through a thick bubble wall and shrugs off a fist.

reply.summary: Vaias is a red-haired, green-eyed gun moll who works as a gang boss's partner in a bygone city of the forties. Vaias threatens rival racketeers, schemes a bank robbery, and is foiled by a masked fast-thinker.

feats.scene: Vaias fires a revolver and cracks a plate-glass window.
Vaias shrugs off a punch from a bodyguard and snarls back.

reply.summary: Estreocol is a former laboratory operative who wore a strongman's alias and a bitter grudge against an animal-powered hero. Estreocol retreated to wooded hills, then to a big city to wage a petty war.

feats.scene: Estreocol lifts a lab table and hurls it through a window.
Estreocol takes a hard tumble down a ravine and keeps hiking.

reply.summary: Nuslas is a red-haired, fresh-faced masked crimefighter from a small town who sets up a new beat in a state capital. Nuslas starts strong, comes home to a horror, and charges in blind with rage before a gunshot ends it.

feats.scene: Nuslas fires a trick arrow that pins a purse-snatcher's coat to a wall.
Nuslas drops from a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Antintas is a towering, pink-eyed mob bruiser who gulped a livestock growth serum and became a living mass of sausage-like tissue. Antintas cannot be cut apart for long, wields a chainsaw, and mutters gory threats.

feats.scene: Antintas swings a chainsaw through a car door and a lamppost in one arc.
Antintas reassembles after being sliced apart and stomps off cheerfully.

reply.summary: Osaseamo is a pair of cackling hyena companions raised by a jester-themed criminal and doted on like babies. Osaseamo hunts by scent, gobbles lost pets, and ends up donated to a city menagerie.

feats.scene: Osaseamo snaps a chain-link fence with a double bite.
Osaseamo tumbles down an embankment and runs on laughing.
Osaseamo chases a van down an alley at a full hyena sprint.

reply.summary: Reovorse is a brace of tame hyenas trained by a clown-faced thief and named after a classic comic duo. Reovorse is infected by a rabid master and put down, then mysteriously returns healthy through a ripple in the calendar.

feats.scene: Reovorse savages a rope and drops a hanging cage.
Reovorse survives a fall from a fire escape and trots away.

reply.summary: Eoncortia is a yellow-furred guard pup who dives after a toy and lands in a tank of rubbery solution, emerging able to twist into any shape. Eoncortia pairs with a caped canine friend to stop thieves and enjoys every stretch.

feats.scene: Eoncortia stretches into a giant fist and thumps a crook off a rooftop.
Eoncortia bounces off a lab wall like a rubber ball.

reply.summary: Tentcel is a bald, semi-retired technician and doting grandfather who guides visiting wanderers around a secret facility. Tentcel works out how a plague twists people into beasts and flees through a shattered city with a child and a lost girl.

feats.scene: Tentcel swings a toolbox at a feral rat and drives it off.
Tentcel scrambles up a stairwell with a child under one arm.

reply.summary: Sorreomi is a meek stock clerk and factory hand who is rebuilt by surgery into a towering red-eyed super-soldier linked to a watchful orbiting machine. Sorreomi stops sinister plans and obeys his handlers across a stark future.

feats.scene: Sorreomi levels a factory wing with a charged beam from his crest.
Sorreomi walks through a barrage of artillery and a collapsing roof.
Sorreomi vaults across a rooftop gap in a single bound.

reply.summary: Ororaia is a bald, black-eyed engineer who helped build a satellite mind and saved a surviving shard of it. Ororaia leads a small party and a grandson into a ruined city, then gets stuck in a bunker as a machine swallows the town.

feats.scene: Ororaia triggers a salvaged charge that opens a sealed hangar.
Ororaia shelters in a bunker as the street above buckles.

reply.summary: Colno is a futuristic champion who fights on the orders and with the help of a watching machine in orbit. Colno scours a ruined beast-ridden age for survivors and serves as a symbol of unlikely strength.

feats.scene: Colno vaporises a mutant war-band's barricade with a pulse from his crest.
Colno trudges through a rain of boulders and tusks.

reply.summary: Tornita is a purple-haired, clumsy janitor who is secretly turned into a hulking enforcer by a distant machine. Tornita bashes a metallic menace in a cartoon team-up and is later stripped of feeling, becoming a cold weapon that ignores bystanders.

feats.scene: Tornita punches a hangar door off its rails and drives a mutated tyrant into a hill.
Tornita stands unmoved in a pummelling of metal fists.
Tornita charges across an arena at a mad sprint.

reply.summary: Oriran is a reformed costumed crook who traded his sauce-slinging ways for an apron and now pours drinks in a back-room tavern for retired rogues. Oriran keeps the peace with business sense and a pitcher of mustard-yellow cocktails.

feats.scene: Oriran slams a bottle on the bar and a brawl falls silent.
Oriran ducks a thrown stool and cleans the counter.

reply.summary: Asnune is a brown-haired oddball hero of a rowdy band of misfits, who says only two words and means a hundred things by them. Asnune courts a tapeworm-infested teammate, duels a squirming rival, and wins her over before their marriage frays.

feats.scene: Asnune scares a rival into submission with one booming word and a glare.
Asnune takes a bar-room beating and orders another round.

reply.summary: Nannus is a blond frontier legend famed for riding, shooting and tracking vast herds across the plains. Nannus stands for a pioneering age and shows up in several overlapping timelines, each version collapsed into one.

feats.scene: Nannus fires a heavy rifle and fells a charging beast at long range.
Nannus is thrown from his horse and rolls to his feet.
Nannus gallops at full tilt across open prairie.

reply.summary: Sortis is a blue-and-white-skinned, red-eyed showman gunslinger in a frontier parody who sings off-key at a saloon karaoke night. Sortis boos a rival off the stage, grabs the microphone, and ignites a brawl that leaves no survivors.

feats.scene: Sortis swings a hooked chain and flattens a saloon wall and three patrons.
Sortis stands up after a dozen revolver shots.
